meta.title: Admin API matrix: roles, reason and date boundaries, end twice = 409, one active override
meta.requirement: AC5 — 401/403, reason.uz 1–280, endsAt > startsAt, expiresAt in (now, now+14 d], ended twice 409, at most one active override, createdById
precondition: API up, QA admin and one QA user token
steps: Call create-closure without token (401) and with the user token (403)
Create closures with reason.uz of 1, 280, 281 and 0 characters; endsAt equal to / after startsAt
Create overrides with expiresAt now+14 d−1 min, +14 d+1 min, in the past; create a second override
End a closure and an override twice
expected: No token → 401 UNAUTHENTICATED; user token → 403 — API response
reason.uz 1 and 280 chars → 201; 281 and 0 → 400; endsAt = startsAt → 400, endsAt > startsAt → 201 — API response
expiresAt now+14 d−1 min → 201; +14 d+1 min → 400; past → 400 — API response
Second end of a closure → 409 CLOSURE_ALREADY_ENDED; second end of an override → 409 OVERRIDE_ALREADY_ENDED — API response
After creating two overrides condition-controls lists exactly one without endedAt (the newer); createdById of the closures = the admin — LOCAL DB row (the API response does not expose it)

caption.expected: No token → 401 UNAUTHENTICATED; user token → 403 — API response

done: API up, QA admin and one QA user token · Peak PLACE
